private_data_risk: private staff contact details, unpublished escalation routes, internal notes
public_release_floor: publish official public channels, role names, digest, and update cadence only
required_redactions: redact private phone numbers, personal emails, internal chat handles, and unpublished escalation notes
synthetic_status: synthetic floor only; no local channel authorization
public_boundary: Public channel evidence is not current voter instruction unless locally refreshed and authorized.
non_claims: not current voter instruction; not live authorization; not certification

private_data_risk: submitter metadata, draft history, unpublished correction notes
public_release_floor: publish notice identifiers, timestamps, digest, official-channel link, and correction status
required_redactions: remove raw submitter metadata, private draft comments, and unnecessary server-side capture metadata
public_boundary: A public notice digest says what artifact was observed; it does not prove motive or outcome effect.
non_claims: not proof of intent or fraud; not outcome certification

private_data_risk: IP addresses, precise location, device fingerprint, browser profile, account identifiers
public_release_floor: publish surface, observation time, coarse vantage class, digest, and divergence code
required_redactions: truncate or remove IP, user-agent, geolocation, account identifiers, cookies, and precise probe route
synthetic_status: synthetic floor only; no live probe approval
public_boundary: Parity evidence shows divergent observed publication states; it does not certify cause or intent.
non_claims: not proof of intent; not proof of suppression; not voter profiling authorization

private_data_risk: witness identity details, internal incident notes, unpublished remediation channels
public_release_floor: publish expected artifact, expected deadline, observation window, witnesses count, and missingness status
required_redactions: redact private witness contact data, internal speculation, and sensitive remediation details
public_boundary: Missingness is an evidence state, not a conclusion about why an artifact is absent.
non_claims: not proof of suppression; not proof of fraud; not outcome certification

private_data_risk: private witness contact data, replacement rota, safety-sensitive affiliation details
public_release_floor: publish witness role, organization when approved, witness-set digest, independence class, and liveness status
required_redactions: redact private contacts, home locations, personal schedules, and safety-sensitive details
public_boundary: A witness set says who checked artifacts; it does not certify the election outcome.
non_claims: not outcome certification; not proof of witness independence without local evidence

private_data_risk: exploit details, unreleased forensic indicators, private recovery contacts, active containment steps
public_release_floor: publish affected key fingerprint, time window, trust downgrade, replacement key digest, and recovery status
required_redactions: withhold exploit reproduction details, private forensic indicators, and sensitive containment routes until reviewed
public_boundary: A key-compromise notice explains evidence trust status; it does not prove the election outcome changed.
non_claims: not outcome proof; not exploit disclosure authorization; not legal advice

private_data_risk: voter names, witness names, precise safety-sensitive location details, law-enforcement contact history
public_release_floor: publish safe escalation route, general incident class, review status, and preservation boundary
required_redactions: redact names, contact data, precise personal location, and unreviewed allegations before public release
reviewer_role: safety reviewer and incident communications owner
public_boundary: Safety bulletins should route help and preserve evidence; they must not expose voters or witnesses.
non_claims: not legal advice; not a factual finding of misconduct; not law-enforcement instruction

private_data_risk: PII in prompts, draft instructions, staff notes, model outputs not approved for publication
public_release_floor: publish AI-assistance disclosure, human approver, approval time, prohibited-use boundary, and correction status
required_redactions: remove prompt PII, voter records, internal drafts, and unapproved model output
public_boundary: AI assistance may support drafting only after human approval; it is not authority.
non_claims: not automated rights determination; not current voter instruction; not legal advice

private_data_risk: reviewer dissent notes, staff names, internal deliberation, unreviewed legal analysis
public_release_floor: publish review trigger, decision class, public boundary, next action, and preservation status
required_redactions: redact private deliberation, staff personal data, sealed legal notes, and unresolved allegations
reviewer_role: human review lead and records custodian
public_boundary: Human review translates evidence status into bounded action; it does not determine legal rights.
non_claims: not legal advice; not proof of wrongdoing; not certification

private_data_risk: sealed material, private evidence pointers, legal work product, personal contact details
public_release_floor: publish packet names, digests, preservation status, sealed flag, and reviewer boundary
required_redactions: separate sealed/private evidence from public digest index and redact work product until counsel review
public_boundary: A public index preserves digest references; it is not an admissibility opinion.
non_claims: not court admissibility determination; not legal advice; not public-records ruling

private_data_risk: maintainer speculation, unreviewed current-authority inference, private reviewer contacts
public_release_floor: publish source IDs, review windows, pinning status, and maintainer action queue
required_redactions: remove speculation about source correctness and private reviewer contact data
public_boundary: Source review triage is a maintainer queue; it is not current voter instruction.
non_claims: not proof a source is wrong; not current public authority; not legal advice

private_data_risk: tamper recipes that could be copied, internal fixture implementation notes
public_release_floor: publish fixture ID, expected failure class, observed fail-closed status, and synthetic boundary
required_redactions: avoid step-by-step exploit recipes beyond what is needed for reproducible synthetic regression
public_boundary: Negative controls show known synthetic tampering is rejected; they do not prove all attacks are detected.
non_claims: not certification; not attack-free proof; not live evidence

private_data_risk: draft sponsor contacts, internal scope negotiations, unpublished exceptions
public_release_floor: publish missing-evidence categories, no-go state, and generic next actions
required_redactions: redact draft local contacts, personal phone numbers, unapproved exceptions, and private scope notes
public_boundary: A local-pilot intake gap matrix does not authorize live use.
non_claims: not live authorization; not current voter instruction; not legal advice

private_data_risk: policy holes that permit accidental publication of private voter, witness, staff, device, or legal-review data
public_release_floor: publish policy IDs, evidence families, decision, missing approval count, and non-claim boundaries
required_redactions: do not publish local private evidence until every applicable policy row has reviewer approval or local exception
reviewer_role: privacy reviewer and public release owner
public_boundary: The redaction gate is a release-safety control; it is not legal advice or a public-records ruling.
non_claims: not legal advice; not public-records ruling; not live deployment evidence
